patterns.message: Logic and data layers stay free of UI and framework code.
Logic and data layers run in the browser: pass Node I/O in as a parameter from scripts/ or a test.

no-restricted-globals.name: window
no-restricted-globals.message: Logic and data layers must not depend on the browser: pass the value in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: document
no-restricted-globals.message: Logic and data layers must not depend on the browser: pass the value in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: navigator
no-restricted-globals.message: Logic and data layers must not depend on the browser: pass the value in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: self
no-restricted-globals.message: Logic and data layers must not depend on the browser: pass the value in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: globalThis
no-restricted-globals.message: Logic and data layers must not depend on the browser: pass the value in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: postMessage
no-restricted-globals.message: Logic and data layers must not depend on the browser: pass the value in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: Persistence goes through the storage adapter: pass load and save in as parameters.

no-restricted-globals.name: sessionStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: Persistence goes through the storage adapter: pass load and save in as parameters.

no-restricted-globals.name: indexedDB
no-restricted-globals.message: Persistence goes through the storage adapter: pass load and save in as parameters.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: I/O stays outside logic and data: pass it in as a parameter (a function such as (url) => Promise<Response>).

no-restricted-globals.name: XMLHttpRequest
no-restricted-globals.message: I/O stays outside logic and data: pass it in as a parameter (a function such as (url) => Promise<Response>).

no-restricted-globals.name: setTimeout
no-restricted-globals.message: Timers are effects: schedule in the UI or pass a scheduler in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: setInterval
no-restricted-globals.message: Timers are effects: schedule in the UI or pass a scheduler in as a parameter.

no-restricted-globals.name: performance
no-restricted-globals.message: The clock is an input: pass the time in as a parameter.

no-restricted-properties.message: The clock is an input: pass the time in as a parameter.
Randomness is an input: use the seeded RNG or pass the bytes in as a parameter.
Reading a File, Blob or Response is I/O: read it in the UI and pass the bytes in as a parameter.
